message:
Concept sketch for "Night Owl" coffee shop — done. Rough SVG sketch is at /private/var/folders/7w/9r4_s1_s42z3f7c136bpjf0r0000gn/T/api30-two-nodes-6Vre2b/beta/data/temp_workspace/night-owl-concept.svg

THE IDEA
A circular badge: an owl face where the owl's two eyes are the rims of two coffee cups seen from above (coffee-brown disc = pupil, small cream dot = highlight), and the steam rising off the cups doubles as the owl's feather tufts / brows. The beak is a single coffee bean. A soft crescent moon sits behind the head as a lighter break in the dark badge — "night" behind the owl. Reads as an owl at 2 seconds, as two cups at 5.

MOOD
Nocturnal, cozy, knowing. Late-night study spot / after-hours refuge, not cute-cartoon and not corporate. Warm and a little mysterious.

IMAGERY
Owl (alert, awake, watchful) + cup + crescent moon + steam. Kept to three shapes so it can be stitched, stamped on a cup sleeve, or cut as a window decal — a one-color version is the real test.

TYPOGRAPHY
Wordmark below the badge: wide-tracked geometric or humanist sans in caps, NIGHT OWL, medium weight, generous letterspacing (0.25em). Optionally swap the "O" in OWL for a small owl-eye/cup rim counter — one gimmick only, no more.
Small line under it: "COFFEE · LATE HOURS" in tiny caps, or nothing at all.

COLOR PALETTE (4 + paper)
- Midnight ink  #2B2A33 — badge, outlines, type
- Espresso     #6B3F2A — coffee/pupil fill
- Brass moon   #C8A15A — moon, steam, bean accent (the "glow")
- Paper cream  #F4EBDF — owl face, reverse type, packaging base
Deliberately no green, no bright accent — the warmth should come from brass + cream on dark.

NEXT STEPS IF IT'S LIKED
Tighten the owl silhouette (it's intentionally loose here), test 16px favicon and a one-color black stamp, then build the full lockup. Say the word if you want me to explore one alternative direction (e.g. moon-and-bean monogram instead of the owl face).
